leah (AE): @omar incoming SIG + CAIQ from MeridianCare. They need answers before their exec review Fri. Key asks: encryption, KMS, SOC2, data residency. Link: https://docs.google.com/sig/meridiancare
leah (AE): also asking if a 4-week POC can use dedicated nodes and what that changes on pricing
omar (Security PM): grabbing this. Is it full SIG or a condensed one?
leah (AE): full SIG ~98 q's. attached network diagram.
omar (Security PM): OK. I'll split into buckets and assign. ETA for initial pass: 48 hours.
jess (SE): I can cover deployment + logging export steps. For KMS note: we support customer-managed keys (AWS/GCP).
leah (AE): customer prefers GCP KMS. pls include sample config and a one-liner on tokenization/embeddings encryption.
omar (Security PM): good. Upload to security queue and tag me so I can create SEC ticket.
intake-bot: ticket SEC-2259 created; owners: omar, jess. target: 2024-06-02.
jess (SE): short draft for embeddings: "Embeddings and model caches are encrypted at rest using AES-256; when configured, CMK via GCP KMS is used."
jess (SE): will add sample gcloud commands for key attach + log export curl by EOD.
omar (Security PM): I'll post the initial answers in the ticket and request legal review for any delegation items. leah, please confirm POC billing preference (reserved vs pilot)
leah (AE): leaning reserved for 4-week pilot. I'll confirm and update the ticket.
omar (Security PM): great. ping in-thread for any blockers.
leah (AE): thanks all :thumbsup:
